raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Batch 14 (ingested 2026-01-19, 378 rows) was delivered with source_tz='UTC', while every earlier batch is America/Chicago local time. The pipeline casts txn_ts without converting it, so the evening of 2026-01-18 in Chicago shows up as 2026-01-19 00:00-04:56. That explains the 99 rows outside opening hours on 2026-01-19 and the low volume on 2026-01-18. All dates are in January (CST, UTC-6, no DST change), so converting the UTC rows to Chicago local time restores the correct txn_ts and txn_date.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.85, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CASE WHEN source_tz = 'UTC' THEN CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL 6 HOUR ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS txn_ts, CAST(CASE WHEN source_tz = 'UTC' THEN CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL 6 HOUR ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
